description: Log books you have read with star ratings and track how many you finish each year.

faqs.a: Enter the title, author, the date you finished, and a 1–5 star rating, then click Log Book.
faqs.q: How do I log a book?

faqs.a: The yearly count card uses the finished date — it counts books logged with a finish date in the current calendar year.
faqs.q: How is the yearly count calculated?

faqs.a: Click the stars before logging. The stars row defaults to 0 (no rating) — tap a star to set 1–5.
faqs.q: How do I rate a book?

faqs.a: Yes, in this browser's localStorage. Your log stays private on this device.
